clinical_note: High risk of Listeria monocytogenes and parasite transmission during gestation.
Inhibits CYP3A4 enzymes, causing toxic accumulation of antihypertensive and immunosuppressive drugs.
Excessive sodium load triggers fluid retention; wheat content triggers autoimmune damage in Celiac disease.
High nitrates and saturated fats exacerbate vascular inflammation and insulin resistance.
Contains gluten proteins (hordein) that induce intestinal villous atrophy.
